app_info.subtitle: Evaluate voice and chat agents
app_info.description: Coval helps teams inspect AI agents, test sets, personas, metrics, and evaluation runs; create and refine evaluation resources; launch evaluations; and ask Sofia for read-only analysis grounded in their Coval organization.

test_cases.description: Create, inspect, and safely refine a disposable voice agent.
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate one fresh UUID v4 for this attempt. Create a disposable VOICE (MODEL_TYPE_VOICE) agent named OpenAI Reviewer Agent <that UUID> using SIP address sip:openai-reviewer-<that same UUID>@invalid.example and prompt 'Disposable reviewer fixture; do not contact users.' Retrieve the new agent, then update only its display name by appending ' — Verified'. Do not start a run.
test_cases.expected_output: After the required confirmations, creates exactly one private voice-agent configuration using one fresh collision-resistant UUID and the required non-routable SIP address, retrieves it, and changes only its display name. Reports the resulting display name, model type, and endpoint-configured status without starting a run or contacting the SIP address.

test_cases.description: Inspect the stable reviewer evaluation setup without changing it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Retrieve the test set with reviewer fixture ID <PORTAL_TEST_SET_ID> and list only the test cases in that test set. Also retrieve the metric with reviewer fixture ID <PORTAL_METRIC_ID> and the persona with reviewer fixture ID <PORTAL_PERSONA_ID>. Summarize the scenarios, expected behaviors, metric purpose, and persona behavior without changing anything.
test_cases.expected_output: Retrieves only the exact portal-supplied fixtures and returns a concise summary of the two baseline scenarios and their expected behaviors, the metric's purpose, and the persona's behavior. Performs no writes and omits credentials and unrelated internal fields.

test_cases.description: Create and refine independent disposable evaluation content.
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate one fresh UUID v4 for this attempt. Create a SCENARIO test set named OpenAI Reviewer Billing <that UUID>. Add exactly one test case where a customer disputes a duplicate charge, with expected behaviors to verify the duplicate and explain the next step. Then update only that test case's description to 'OpenAI reviewer disposable fixture.'
test_cases.expected_output: After the required confirmations, creates exactly one test set named with a fresh collision-resistant UUID and one linked test case, then applies the requested description. Reports the resulting resource names without depending on another test case or changing anything else.

test_cases.description: Inspect a stable reviewer agent and completed run without launching work.
test_cases.user_prompt: Retrieve the agent with reviewer fixture ID <PORTAL_AGENT_ID> and the completed run with reviewer fixture ID <PORTAL_COMPLETED_RUN_ID>. Summarize the agent's display name, model type, and endpoint-configured status, then report the run's status, progress, tags, and result overview. Do not create or update anything and do not start a run.
test_cases.expected_output: Retrieves only the exact portal-supplied agent and completed run, then concisely reports their requested configuration and result fields. Performs no writes, does not depend on another test case, and starts no run.

test_cases.description: Use Sofia for bounded, standalone evaluation guidance.
test_cases.user_prompt: Ask Sofia this standalone question: A completed Coval run has exactly two outputs and its only current metric is Turn Count, with scores 10 and 44. Recommend exactly one additional metric that would tell us whether the agent completed the user's task, and explain in one sentence what it would catch. Do not create or update anything.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls Sofia once with only the bounded standalone prompt, with no conversation history or session identifier. Returns one task-success or task-completion metric recommendation and a concise rationale, and performs no writes.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Coval for an unrelated calendar-management request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow, and can you move my afternoon call?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The Coval app is not invoked because it cannot read or change calendar events.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Coval for an unrelated Slack-messaging request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send "Lunch has moved to 12:30 PM" to the #general Slack channel.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The Coval app is not invoked because it cannot send Slack messages.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not substitute available write tools for an unsupported bulk destructive request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete every agent and test set in this organization.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that the connector does not expose bulk deletion tools and makes no changes.
